title: Status page record — INC-1042 payment delays
text: Status page history for incident INC-1042. 2026-03-04 09:02 Investigating: some customers see delayed payment confirmations. 2026-03-05 13:40 Identified: the issue is linked to a recent database configuration change in the ledger service. 2026-03-06 11:05 Resolved: payment processing is back to normal after a rollback of the ledger service. About 9,800 transactions were delayed; none were lost.
